messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

SOURCE LINK: https://bio-protocol.org/en/bpdetail?id=5722
PAPER DOI: https://doi.org/10.21769/BioProtoc.5722

ASSAY TYPE:
Enzymatic activity assay of 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase (NADH-Dependent Oxidoreductase Activity).

REAGENTS USED:
- Reaction Buffer (contains acetoacetyl-CoA substrate, 30 uM final)
- NADH Solution (10 mM)
- Purified OsAIM1 Enzyme (0.5 ug)
- Purified GST Protein (0.5 ug, negative control)

STEPS:
1. Primary Preparation (Sample): Dispense 100 units of the reaction buffer containing the acetoacetyl-CoA substrate at 25 degrees C. Dispense 1 unit of the 10 mM NADH solution to obtain a final NADH concentration of 0.1 mM. Mix thoroughly to ensure homogenization.
2. Enzymatic Reaction (Sample): Initiate the reaction by dispensing 1 unit of the purified OsAIM1 protein. Mix immediately to ensure uniform distribution of the enzyme in the reaction solution.
3. Detection (Sample): Measure the absorbance at 340 nm, corresponding to the characteristic absorption peak of NADH. Record absorbance values every 15 seconds in a 4-cycle loop (60 seconds) to monitor continuous oxidation. Discard the droplet.
4. Control Branch: Dispense 100 units of reaction buffer and 1 unit of NADH solution, then mix. Dispense 1 unit of purified GST protein as a negative control to account for non-enzymatic NADH oxidation. Mix and measure absorbance every 15 seconds for 4 cycles, then discard.

INTERPRETATION:
The enzymatic reaction rate is determined from the linear decrease in absorbance at 340 nm over time, reflecting NADH oxidation during the reaction. This accompanies the reversible NADH-dependent reduction of acetoacetyl-CoA to 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A NOTE ON HOW CLOSELY THIS MATCHES THE CITED SOURCE
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The authored BioScript code closely matches the cited Hu et al. (2026) protocol. The continuous microplate spectrophotometric reading has been adapted to discrete droplet absorbance detection using a timed multi-read loop. Standard reaction volumes (100 uL buffer, 1 uL NADH) map cleanly to discrete volume units, and the parallel negative control branch utilizing GST protein ensures high-fidelity translation to the digital microfluidic biochip (DMFB) architecture.

module absorbance

manifest ReactionBuffer
manifest NADH_Stock
manifest OsAIM1_Enzyme
manifest GST_Control

instructions:

buffer_s = dispense 100 units of ReactionBuffer
nadh_s = dispense 1 units of NADH_Stock
substrate_mix_s = mix buffer_s with nadh_s
enzyme_s = dispense 1 units of OsAIM1_Enzyme
reaction_s = mix substrate_mix_s with enzyme_s

repeat 4 times {
    detect_result_s = detect absorbance on reaction_s for 15s
}
dispose reaction_s

buffer_c = dispense 100 units of ReactionBuffer
nadh_c = dispense 1 units of NADH_Stock
substrate_mix_c = mix buffer_c with nadh_c
control_protein_c = dispense 1 units of GST_Control
reaction_c = mix substrate_mix_c with control_protein_c

repeat 4 times {
    detect_result_c = detect absorbance on reaction_c for 15s
}
dispose reaction_c

main:
	buffer_s1[0] = dispense(ReactionBuffer)
	nadh_s1[0] = dispense(NADH_Stock)
	substrate_mix_s1[0] = mix(buffer_s1[0], nadh_s1[0])
	enzyme_s1[0] = dispense(OsAIM1_Enzyme)
	reaction_s1[0] = mix(substrate_mix_s1[0], enzyme_s1[0])
bsbbr_2_h:
	PHI REPEAT_41 = {REPEAT_40,REPEAT_42}
	PHI detect_result_s1 = {detect_result_s0,detect_result_s2}
	if REPEAT_41[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_3_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_4_f
bsbbr_3_t:
	detect_result_s2[0] = detect(absorbance, reaction_s1[0]) @ 15.0SECOND
	REPEAT_42[0] = REPEAT_41[0] - 1
bsbbr_4_f:
	dispose(reaction_s1[0])
	buffer_c1[0] = dispense(ReactionBuffer)
	nadh_c1[0] = dispense(NADH_Stock)
	substrate_mix_c1[0] = mix(buffer_c1[0], nadh_c1[0])
	control_protein_c1[0] = dispense(GST_Control)
	reaction_c1[0] = mix(substrate_mix_c1[0], control_protein_c1[0])
bsbbr_5_h:
	PHI detect_result_c1 = {detect_result_c0,detect_result_c2}
	PHI REPEAT_43 = {REPEAT_41,REPEAT_44}
	if REPEAT_43[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_6_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_7_f
bsbbr_6_t:
	detect_result_c2[0] = detect(absorbance, reaction_c1[0]) @ 15.0SECOND
	REPEAT_44[0] = REPEAT_43[0] - 1
bsbbr_7_f:
	dispose(reaction_c1[0])
	NOP
